I am a PhD candidate at LSE’s European Institute and I am affiliated with the [Data Science Institute](https://www.lse.ac.uk/DSI) at LSE.

I study how political and civic actions influence how citizens think about politics. I am especially interested in the attitudinal and behavioural consequences of citizens' everyday interactions with the state, and, as artificial intelligence becomes more prevalent, in how it reshapes them. I study these topics with observational causal inference, field experiments, and mixed-methods research designs. 

My work is forthcoming in [*Perspectives on Politics*](https://doi.org/10.1017/S1537592726105775){target="_blank"}.

Before joining the European Institute, I obtained an MSc in Social Research Methods (London School of Economics) and a BA in History and Politics (University of Exeter). You can find here my [CV](EPro_CV.pdf){target="_blank"}.

I also love learning and writing about study methods and note-taking techniques, hoping to make academia a bit less daunting and more accessible to everyone. Check out my [blog](https://elenapro.substack.com/){target="_blank"}!

If any of this interests you, please get in touch at [e.pro\@lse.ac.uk](mailto:e.pro@lse.ac.uk).

You can also find me on  [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/elenapro.bsky.social){target="_blank"}, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/elena-pro-69a9a41a1/){target="_blank"}, and [GitHub](https://github.com/elena-pr){target="_blank"}.
